description: Find messages similar to a given message using its embedding vector. Useful for finding related discussions or duplicate threads.

inbox.description: Mailing list name, e.g. pgsql-general. Defaults to pgsql-hackers when omitted. Aliases: list, inbox_name.

message_id.description: Message-ID of the message to find similar messages for, or a message URL (postgr.es/m/..., postgresql.org/message-id/..., pg.ddx.io/m/...)

name: find_similar_messages
